shared_elements: bearded male head with rows of curls
patterned/incised rendering of hair and fringed detail
figures moving with one leg advanced
justification: Both surfaces render human males in strict profile with heavily patterned, tightly curled beards and hair and firmly modelled limbs in shallow relief, a shared and fairly specific figural convention. However, A is a single monumental static figure with large feathered wings and a raised hand filling the whole field, while B is a crowded horizontal narrative of small running figures, chariots with spoked wheels, animals and swimming/fallen bodies, so the subject matter, relationships and layout scarcely overlap.
